review_text: The search filters reset every time I reopen the app. I lose my place and have to rebuild the view.
Billing charged me twice for the annual plan. Support fixed it within a day, but the invoice still shows both charges.
I cannot export a board to CSV. The button spins forever and then nothing happens.
The new table view is fast and the keyboard shortcuts are exactly what I needed.
Adding a second workspace is confusing. The settings page never explains what gets shared.
The weekly digest keeps arriving on Sunday even though I set Monday in preferences.
Card colors are useful, but I want to save a filtered view for my whole team.
The new onboarding checklist was clear and saved me a support call.
Dragging a card on mobile is almost impossible. It keeps opening the card instead.
The audit log helped us find who changed the workspace permissions. Please add export.
I would like a dark theme for the editor. Light mode is hard on long sessions.
Our integration stopped syncing after the last update. No error message anywhere.
